def comps_of(g, conn='8'):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    offs=[(dx,dy) for dx in(-1,0,1) for dy in(-1,0,1) if (dx,dy)!=(0,0)]
    offs4=[(dx,dy) for dx in(-1,0,1) for dy in(-1,0,1) if abs(dx)+abs(dy)==1]
    O=offs if conn=='8' else offs4
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==1 and not seen[i][j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; s=set()
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); s.add((a,b))
                    for dx,dy in O:
                        x,y=a+dx,b+dy
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==1 and not seen[x][y]:
                            seen[x][y]=True; q.append((x,y))
                out.append(s)
    return out

def analyze(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    res=[]
    for i in range(len(gi)):
        for j in range(len(gi[0])):
            if gi[i][j]!=0: continue
            v=go[i][j]
            d=min(max(abs(i-x),abs(j-y)) for x,y in sum(comps_of(gi,'8'),[]))
            nb8=[(x,y) for x in range(max(0,i-1),min(len(gi)-1,i+2)) for y in range(max(0,j-1),min(len(gi[0])-1,j+2))]
            adj8=any(gi[x][y]==1 for x,y in nb8)
            adj4=any(abs(x-i)+abs(y-j)==1 and gi[x][y]==1 for x,y in nb8)
            enc=False
            # enclosure precalc later
            for c in comps_of(gi,'8'):
                rs=[x for x,_ in c]; cs=[y for _,y in c]
                r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
                inside=r0<i<r1 and c0<j<c1
                res.append((k,i,j,v,d,adj8,adj4,inside,c))
    return res
allr=[]
for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3'):
    allr+=analyze(k)

from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def feats(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bxs=[]
    for c in comps_of(gi,'8'):
        rs=[x for x,_ in c]; cs=[y for _,y in c]
        bxs.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j]!=0: continue
            v=go[i][j]
            enc = visof(gi)[i][j]          # touches border
            nb=sum(1 for x in range(max(0,i-1),min(H-1,i+2)) for y in range(max(0,j-1),min(W-1,j+2)) if (x,y)!=(i,j) and gi[x][y]==1)
            adj4 = any(abs(x-i)+abs(y-j)==1 and gi[x][y]==1 for x in range(max(0,i-1),min(H-1,i+2)) for y in range(max(0,j-1),min(W-1,j+2)))
            ins = any(r0<i<r1 and c0<j<c1 for r0,r1,c0,c1 in bxs)
            res.append((k,i,j,v,not enc,nb>=1,adj4,ins,bxs))
    return res
for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3'):
    t=feats(k)
    byv=defaultdict(list)
    for r in t: byv[r[3]].append(r)
    for vv in sorted(byv):
        lst=byv[vv]
        print('---',k,'->',vv, len(lst))
        print('   adj8 | enc | inside_bbox')
        for r in lst[:12]: print('   ',f'{r[4]}{r[5]:>1}{r[6]:>2}  ({r[2]}, {r[1]:d})')

Background (0-valued cells not in any component?) Actually all zero cells belong to the big component via 8-conn through borders? Border zeros connect around.
